status: post-result exploratory extension; not a prospectively registered study
target: W0 PP-NRS >=4 and measured W12 PP-NRS at least4 points lower than measured W0
clinical_eligibility: Current age>=12, unambiguous initial dose, same163-patient clinical comparison population
adolescent_DLQI: Unavailable for ages<18; training-fold median predictor imputation only, no response imputation
primary_population: Both observed PP-NRS measurements, baseline >=4 and all three baseline serum readings finite
sensitivity_population: At least one observed baseline marker; training-fold median replaces missing predictor concentrations; no missingness flag; does not create observed blood measurements
no_blood_samples: Not predicted by serum model; retained in clinical eligibility accounting only
primary_evaluation: Mean of separately scored outer-repetition OOF metrics
historical_comparison_evaluation: Metrics of repeat-averaged patient probabilities, reported separately
bootstrap_scope: Paired patient resamples retaining every saved repetition, conditional on fitted OOF predictions; not a full model-development interval
reference: Clinical model; paired combined-minus-clinical AUROC and Brier
null_model: Each outer training-fold event rate, evaluated on its held-out patients
model_scope: Baseline-only prospective prediction of binary itch improvement, distinct from contemporaneous E-EASI frozen equation
selection_boundary: Three-panel composition fixed from earlier same-cohort exploration; no independent validation or universal clinical AUC threshold
publication_rule: Report all three comparisons together. If serum-only AUC lower conditional95%bound>.5 it may be described as exploratory discrimination. Claim incremental value only with paired delta AUC lower bound>0 and no probability-error deterioration. Sparse nonresponse and post hoc design must remain explicit.
